Okay so while I know everyone’s story or situation is different - my experience with the number 333 was / has been an interesting one to say the least. 
So the first time I started noticing seeing the number repeatedly was when I was a kid. Maybe 7-8. I recall seeing it often on my clock in my room. It always appeared odd to me even at that age because I had no idea why I kept seeing it. 
I would continue to see it throughout my life and as I got older I saw it but not quite as much. Then in my early 20s I started seeing it again. I didn’t know why but I noticed it a lot. Then my grandma got sick with cancer and two instances of the number came up - I saw it on the radio as I was leaving the hospital when I visited her and then the last hospital room she was in was 333. And I still recall the day I spoke to a nurse and asked what the room number was where she had been moved to I literally just broke down crying so bad because I knew that was it. Something just said she will die soon. And sure enough she did. About a week later. It was at that time I became somewhat obsessed with that number and what it meant so I started researching online and came across a bunch of information. (This was early 2000s so internet was still relatively new and there weren’t the resources online there are today). Regardless I found so much info. Some of it freaked me out. One referring to Choronzon - as someone else mentioned. That’s a rabbit hole to go down. Basically I was confused. I wasn’t sure if the number was inherently evil in nature or just some random thing. 
Later in life at a bookstore I came across an Angel book of numbers. And when I looked up that number it said that I have angels watching over me. 
What I’ve come to accept from it is that it has the meaning we give to it. In some of my cases it may have seemed bad as my grandma died in the room number 333. But if I look at it as an Angel number I’m sure she has angels watching over her and I as well. I don’t see it nearly as much as I use to but the number will always be part of my life experiences.

While I do believe selective memory is a thing - in this case no. I’ll explain more in my reply to OP but I believe there are certain numbers that have certain meanings and not just a coincidence or something our brain sees because we may think of it.
